description: A published set of IC-JPA lesson-planning materials, checklists, student task cards, and academic-language supports for elementary mathematics instruction with English Language Learners.
title: IC-JPA Lesson Plan and Task Card materials

description: A multifaceted deep-learning system developed by Yilmaz Recai et al.
title: ICEMS (Intelligent Continuous Expertise Monitoring System)

description: A 16-item conventional-format test developed for ICILS 2023 in Flanders to measure lower-secondary teachers’ and senior pre-service teachers’ computational-thinking content knowledge across five framework aspects.
title: ICILS 2023 Flanders instrument measuring teachers’ computational thinking content knowledge

description: ICNALE is a controlled learner corpus of argumentative English essays from Asian EFL learners and native English speakers, created and maintained by the International Corpus Network of Asian Learners of English.
title: ICNALE

description: A publicly available dataset derived from ICNALE, released by Stefano Bannò and colleagues, containing L2 English learner essays and speeches with holistic and analytic ratings from an English-as-a-Lingua-Franca assessment perspective.
title: ICNALE Global Rating Archive (GRA) dataset

description: A 34-item formative workplace-based assessment tool developed by the International Council of Ophthalmology to evaluate ophthalmology residents’ non-procedural patient-encounter skills using behaviorally descriptive Dreyfus-based rating levels.
title: ICO-OCEX (International Council of Ophthalmology-Ophthalmic Clinical Evaluation Exercise)

description: A proposed intelligent learning-environment architecture that models students' cultural and linguistic backgrounds and dynamically adapts educational content through a contextual student model, repository, language adapter, and controller.
title: ICON (Instructional Cultural cONtextualisation) system

description: An open-access collection of 200 multilingual virtual patients created by the iCoViP project and implemented in the CASUS learning system for medical students’ clinical-reasoning training.
title: iCoViP virtual patient collection and CASUS VP system

description: ICU Simulator is a browser-based, client-side educational simulation platform developed by İnan Onur and Akyüz Ali for practicing biomedical-device operation and troubleshooting.
title: ICU Simulator
